title: JamOnBread‘s NFT Smart Contract with revenue sharing mechanism for whole Cardano NFT space to use!

ms.promise:
A document summarizing the design of Smart Contract solution with revenue sharing mechanism so that Aiken developer can build such Smart Contract. Doc will include:
・Technical and product requirements including graphical representation of revenue-splitting mechanism
・Vision for the Smart Contract logic
・Use cases and opportunities for builders and users.

ms.criteria:
Smart Contract that can fulfil the design requirements: (this is jut an example - detailed requirements are part of previous milestone - design)
Multiple affiliate levels and dynamically splits transaction fees based on many factors. These factors include the marketplace where the NFT was listed, the marketplace where the sale occurred, and the contributors involved in the NFT sale (link affiliate).
ms.report: Instant buy/sell/offer Smart Contract with revenue sharing mechanism -> https://github.com/JamOnBread/contract

ms.promise:
Completed security audit with an internal documentation describing potential vulnerabilities and potentially problematic features. Audit will include: Aiken script security audit, code review, script structure design consulting.
Design review and internal audit will be conducted by Vacuum Labs - https://vacuumlabs.com/blockchain/smart-contract-auditing/ 
Security audit will be conducted by Sundaeswap - https://sundae.fi/services
ms.criteria: Audit conducted by a reputable company that will reveal both critical and non-critical vulnerabilities. Final verdict whether finalized and adjusted SC can be deployed.
ms.report:
Sundae Labs Security Audit has been finished with public report accessible at https://jamonbread-io.gitbook.io/jamonbread/marketplace/audits (https://cdn.sundaeswap.finance/audits/jam-on-bread.pdf)
Internal Audit by Vacuum Labs. As per explanation in the gitbook section the design and code review done was intended only for internal purposes and therefore we can only present the results in our own words as per gitbook section.

ms.report:
Code optimization and fixing vulnerabilities
Code optimization based on security audit have been applied. Pages 19 and 20 in the report describe the exact findings. Each finding, based on its severity, has its recommendation and if the finding was necessary to be resolved then exact resolution with commit hash is attached:
https://cdn.sundaeswap.finance/audits/jam-on-bread.pdf
Major changes during both Internal audit and Security Audit are also summarized on: 
https://github.com/JamOnBread/contract
Deployment on testnet and testing phase
First internal testnet deployment and testing was conducted following by public testnet release accessible on: 
https://testnet-prod.jamonbread.tech/
Sample test transaction are listed in this gitbook section bellow:
https://jamonbread-io.gitbook.io/jamonbread/devs/transactions
Deployment on mainnet (utilize SC via SDK)
Since SC is open-sourced all documentation is summarized in: 
https://github.com/JamOnBread/contract
Intended use of this SC is to not fractionalize asset's liquidity by listing into multiple separately deployed contracts but to use the already deployed version and utilize its liquidity and listings by connecting to it via SDK. Complete manual for any business to utilize the listings and liquidity is to be found on link bellow:
 https://github.com/JamOnBread/contract-lib
